description: We are Team CMS Senior from Lahore, Pakistan, in South Asia. We compete in robotics, coding and STEM competitions, and every one of them has been fully self-funded. We do everything ourselves, from code and building hardware to design and presenting our work. We believe in being honest about every resource, AI tool and technology we use. What drives us is curiosity, the urge to achieve more, and the ambition to excel in every field. Our team comprises of highschoolers and young graduates.
